title: CoverageGap
description: A CoverageGap is a first-class SOURCING-LAYER record. It describes an identified weakness in source coverage along a specific dimension (country, workstream, topic, source_class, source_subtype, language, entity set, time horizon, refresh/freshness, source quality, access/legal, or pointer expansion). Its job is to let the Coverage Auditor know what is missing, weak, stale, inaccessible, legally blocked, under-searched, or dependent on human review. It is NOT Evidence, a Claim, a Signal, a BankNeed, or an Opportunity, and must not contain final market intelligence - description and why_it_matters describe COVERAGE, not market conclusions, and the 'basis' object holds only ID links to other sourcing records (not Evidence objects). Two orthogonal axes: coverage_dimension = which axis of coverage is weak; gap_type = the nature of the weakness.

gap_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this coverage gap.

discovery_run_id.description: Identifier of the run that identified or last updated this gap; links to data/run_logs.

created_at.description: When the gap was created (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time).

updated_at.description: When the gap was last updated (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time).

gap_status.description: Lifecycle status of the gap. 'accepted' = acknowledged but deliberately not being closed now. When 'resolved', resolution.resolution_ref must be set; when 'superseded', resolution.superseded_by_gap_id must be set (both enforced below).

gap_type.description: Nature of the weakness. missing = no coverage/candidates at all; weak = some coverage but insufficient; stale = coverage exists but is outdated; inaccessible = useful sources exist but cannot be accessed; legally_blocked = blocked for legal/policy reasons; under_searched = not enough searching done yet; unexpanded_pointer = known pointer sources not yet expanded; needs_human_review = closing the gap depends on human review; low_quality = sources exist but are too low-quality; unknown = nature not yet determined.

coverage_dimension.description: Which axis of coverage (architecture section 14) this gap is about.

severity.description: Importance of the gap itself (how much it weakens coverage).

confidence_score.description: Confidence that this is a real coverage gap, 0..1.

sector.description: Which side of Printec's market this gap concerns.

workstream.description: Workstream code per architecture section 16 (A7 is intentionally not defined).

topics.description: Non-empty list of topics the gap concerns. Plural for consistency with SourceCandidate.topics / NegativeFinding.topics.

source_class.description: Source class dimension of the gap. SourceCandidate uses only direct/indirect/pointer; CoverageGap (like NegativeFinding) also allows 'unknown' and 'not_applicable' for gaps not tied to a specific class.

source_subtype.description: Optional finer source-type classification, aligned with SourceCandidate.source_subtype (e.g. 'procurement_portal', 'job_board', 'bank_register'). Lets gaps be tracked at source-type granularity. Optional; omit when not applicable.

language.description: The SEARCH/COVERAGE language dimension of the gap (not a source's primary language) as a BCP-47-like tag where possible, e.g. 'el', 'en', or the literal 'unknown'. Lenient shape check, not full BCP-47 validation.

time_horizon.description: Optional time-horizon dimension (architecture section 14 / section 1). near_term ~6-12 months, mid_term ~1-3 years, long_term ~3-5 years. Omit or use 'not_applicable' when the gap is horizon-agnostic.

access_status.description: Optional access dimension, reusing SourceCandidate.access_status. Set when the gap is about access (coverage_dimension access_legal / gap_type inaccessible).

legal_status.description: Optional legal dimension, reusing SourceCandidate.legal_status. Set when the gap is about legal/policy blocking.

related_entities.description: Optional entity set the gap concerns (e.g. 'Greek systemic banks', a regulator, a vendor). Supports entity_set gaps.

description.description: What the coverage weakness is (coverage-meta, not market intelligence). Required non-empty.

why_it_matters.description: Why this gap matters for coverage completeness, decision confidence, or knowing what we do not know. Required non-empty.

basis.description: ID links substantiating the gap. Links only - holds no Evidence objects and no market intelligence.

linked_negative_finding_ids.description: NegativeFinding finding_ids that evidence this gap. May be empty.

linked_candidate_ids.description: SourceCandidate candidate_ids relevant to this gap. May be empty.

linked_source_ids.description: Source Registry source_ids relevant to this gap. May be empty.

linked_access_review_task_ids.description: AccessReviewTask task_ids relevant to this gap. May be empty.

follow_up.description: Follow-up state and remediation recommendation. Null-valued fields are expected before follow-up is assigned.

recommended_action.description: Recommended action to close or manage the gap. Use follow_up_notes to explain 'other'.

assigned_to.description: Person or queue responsible for follow-up; null if unassigned. Named 'assigned_to' for consistency with AccessReviewTask / NegativeFinding.

due_at.description: When follow-up is due (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time); null if none.

follow_up_notes.description: Free-text follow-up notes; null if none.

resolution.description: Resolution/supersession detail. Null-valued fields are expected until the gap is resolved or superseded.

resolution_ref.description: Reference to what closed the gap (e.g. a source_id, candidate_id, or note). Must be a non-empty string when gap_status is 'resolved' (enforced below); null otherwise.

resolution_reason.description: Free-text reason/explanation of the resolution; null if none.

resolved_at.description: When resolved (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time); null until resolved.

resolved_by.description: Who resolved the gap; null until resolved.

superseded_by_gap_id.description: gap_id that supersedes this one. Must be a non-empty string when gap_status is 'superseded' (enforced below); null otherwise.

metadata.description: Optional free-form extension bag. This is the ONLY place additional properties are allowed.
